name: Lesson 15 · The day: separable verbs (aufstehen, anrufen, einkaufen…)

cards.note: Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. aufstehen splits: the verb stands second, the prefix auf goes to the very end.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. In a question too, auf goes to the end.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. er steht … auf: the prefix closes the sentence.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. The verb second after am Sonntag; auf at the end.

cards.front: In the morning I **get up** at half past six.
cards.back: Am Morgen **stehe** ich um halb sieben **auf**.
cards.note: Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. am Morgen: in the morning. auf waits for the end.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. anrufen: rufe second, an last. The person called is in the accusative.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. The verb opens the question; an still closes it.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. sie ruft … an.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. ihr ruft … an.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. einkaufen: kaufen second, ein last.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. er kauft … ein.

cards.front: **Do** you **watch TV** in the evening? (one friend)
cards.note: Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. fernsehen keeps the vowel change of sehen: du siehst … fern.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. er sieht … fern: ie, as in sehen.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. ich sehe … fern.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. am Abend first, the verb second, fern last.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. mitkommen: kommst first in the question, mit last.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. sie kommt … mit.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. ihr kommt … mit.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. nicht goes before the prefix: nicht mit.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. anfangen changes a to ä like fahren: er fängt … an.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. fängt … an, with the umlaut.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. aufräumen: räume second, auf last.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. abholen: holst … ab, like English pick … up.

cards.front: I **pick up** my son at four.
cards.note: Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. The object and the time go inside: hole … ab.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. wer takes the er form: holt … ab.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. aufmachen: macht … auf, to open.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. zumachen: macht … zu, to close; the opposite of aufmachen.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. frühstücken does not split: früh- is not a prefix here, just part of the word.

cards.front: I have to **get up** early tomorrow.
cards.note: Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. With a modal, the separable verb is one word again, at the end: aufstehen.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. After a modal, anrufen stays whole at the end.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. fernsehen in one word after wollen.
Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. möchten + mitkommen, together at the end.

cards.front: I have to **do the shopping** today.
cards.note: Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. The infinitive is never split.

cards.front: You have to **tidy up** your room. (one friend)
cards.note: Separable verbs: the prefix goes to the end. aufräumen, whole, at the end.
